title: Fresh-primary delta for the strategy-reopening gap in autonomous AI R&D

canonical_primary_evidence_presence.interpretation: This is a fresh-primary search delta only. Absence from the canonical pool does not itself establish novelty or authorize ingestion, promotion, or experimentation.

primary_source.title: What is Missing from AI Post-Training AI: An Empirical Analysis
primary_source.role: fresh empirical phenomenon and observational-proxy boundary

grounded_findings.statement: Across 3,557 adjacent training-iteration pairs, the source annotates 74 strategy changes (2.1%), while local execution changes are much more common.
grounded_findings.scope: the source's released post-training trajectories and conservative strategy annotations

grounded_findings.statement: The evaluator can expose decision-relevant diagnoses and alternative strategy suggestions, yet the reported main-agent behavior adopts execution-level suggestions while failing to adopt observed strategy-level recommendations in the audited examples.
grounded_findings.scope: the source's evaluator/journal intervention analysis; not a population causal effect

grounded_findings.statement: A pre-training human review can induce a high-level strategy revision that the agent understands and executes, while later negative training evidence tends to produce within-strategy adjustment rather than spontaneous strategy reopening.
grounded_findings.scope: the source's human-guidance intervention and subsequent training behavior

grounded_findings.statement: The source measures whether strategy changes occur, but the released observational record does not by itself distinguish failure to recognize strategy-disconfirming evidence from failure to expose the current strategy as an in-run decision variable after such evidence is recognized.
grounded_findings.scope: candidate-side interpretation of the source's measurement boundary; requires a new controlled decomposition before it can become a scientific claim

source_limitations_relevant_to_candidate: The cross-agent observational analysis cannot isolate model, prompt, interface, and scaffold contributions.
A strategy switch is not intrinsically beneficial; a correct decision may be to keep the current strategy.
The source demonstrates strategy lock-in but does not perform a same-information recognition-versus-reopening intervention.

public_support_artifacts.intended_use: support-feasibility and prefix inventory only until an exact replay/runtime contract is qualified
